long_biography.plain_text:
After graduating summa cum laude from Lafayette College in economics and business, Russo joined the family development company. He became president and chief operating officer in 2001. An early test came when he committed his savings to due diligence on a difficult New Jersey industrial site, secured approvals and completed a fully leased warehouse. That project established a more ambitious approach to complex redevelopment.

Now chief executive, Russo oversees acquisition, design, entitlements, construction, leasing, finance and property management. Under his leadership, the firm extended its industrial base into data centers, apartment communities and mixed-use projects across New Jersey. He also manages development entities and holds a controlling interest in at least one project-company chain. Ownership of the parent company between generations remains undisclosed.
